zh: 新增微信公众号扫码登录，并支持与已有账号绑定
新增自助注销账号功能，可在设置中永久删除账号
优化登录弹窗：根据内容自动调整尺寸，并消除打开动画期间残留的滚动条
修复浮动窗口在自适应内容尺寸时未保持居中的问题
修复折叠文件夹预览图标与展开后渲染不一致的问题
将网站图标更换为品牌 Logo
en: Added WeChat Official Account scan-to-login, with binding to an existing account
Added self-service account deletion to permanently remove your account from Settings
Auth dialog now auto-sizes to its content and no longer shows a stray scrollbar during the open animation
Fixed floating windows not staying centered when auto-fitting to their content
Fixed collapsed folder preview icons not matching their in-folder rendering
Switched the site favicon to the brand logo

zh: 修复在触摸屏上拖动或缩放浮动窗口（热榜、AI 助手）时窗口跳动或意外收起的问题
en: Fixed floating windows (Trending and AI assistant) jumping or collapsing when dragged or resized on touch screens

zh: 日历详情页支持点击右侧节日跳转到对应日期
日历详情页新增年份与月份快速选择
新增一键添加倒计时小组件：选中日期后即可在桌面创建倒计时
修复本月节日列表在点击节日后条目消失的问题
en: Calendar detail: click a festival in the sidebar to jump to its date
Calendar detail: added a quick year/month picker
Added one-click countdown widgets: pick a date and create a countdown on the desktop
Fixed the monthly festival list losing entries after clicking a festival

zh: 设置中新增「关于」页，可查看当前版本与更新日志
优化设置侧边栏图标与文字的对齐
en: Added an About page in Settings showing the current version and changelog
Improved icon and text alignment in the settings sidebar

zh: 新增日历详情弹窗，可查看节日与日程
新增链接打开方式设置（当前标签页 / 新标签页）
增强桌面小组件与浮动窗口
便签内容与毛玻璃渲染更稳定
改进网站图标与链接图标的回退显示
优化桌面交互、右键菜单与设置窗口拖拽性能
en: Added a calendar detail modal for holidays and events
Added a link open mode setting (current vs. new tab)
Enhanced desktop widgets and floating windows
More reliable sticky notes and glassmorphism rendering
Improved favicon and fallback link icon display
Optimized desktop interactions, context menus, and settings window drag performance

zh: CatHeadTab 首个版本：可自定义的新标签页桌面
支持壁纸（内置 / 本地 / Wallhaven）、书签与历史记录
内置时钟、天气、汇率、股票、热榜等多种小组件
集成 AI 助手，支持中英双语
en: First release of CatHeadTab: a customizable new-tab desktop
Wallpapers (built-in / local / Wallhaven), bookmarks, and history
Built-in widgets: clock, weather, exchange rates, stocks, trending, and more
AI assistant with bilingual (English / Chinese) support
